authorship: Expanded hand-authored conversations for intent-space evaluation; no catalog targets or simulator hidden state.
oracle_policy: Each conversation carries one expected-transition tag. Narrower and broader conversations score first-to-last scalar direction, stable conversations allow ten percent relative movement, and override conversations are observational. Progressive conversations also retain their intermediate state for adjacent-turn diagnostics. Known QU failure cases additionally carry retrieval-changing semantic assertions.
